payload.text: THE DAY AFTER 3.2.5, LATE EVENING (vc, 2026-10-23, after the second bounce). The line is drawn and 3.2.6 is a patch (decision 70); every open issue carries its spec in its record. (1) CLOSED today: 0622, 0626, 0611, 0628, 0627 (37ba1be83 / 46b16553f), 0624 (6a95721f2 / 2b486174f), 0614 (landed 8f1fda69b, closed c59e80779), 0623 (fixed 6bd64b1c8, shots refreshed f2ece5503, closed b5e0fd2b3). LANDED: the preflight gate at f40df8f72 (dc, on vc's ruling under the pen: a push to upstream needs a green kovacs summary covering each pushed commit; a green at S covers P through board-only commits and the driver's own stamp known by its diff; `bin/devbin build release` asks `bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD` and stops before it stamps; the order is in the tree at bin/.devbin/preflight-linux.sh and copies its summary to ~/.local/share/intent/preflight/<sha>.summary; releasing.md step 2 gained the sub-bullet). The installed pair is c59e80779 (vc's build all at 18:41Z, intentd restarted). The folds before the second bounce: ic 97b82e496, cc 39f0244e7, dc 3c08966c9 then b129c1b91 (the guards pass done in dc's lane: Prodinfra fa4b6a3, Lamplight 7cfa606a5, Conflab ff4d7441, Trellis e07fce8, Anvil 95eff25, Courses 076d6e7, each on a fresh dry run on the pair; Molt is molt-vc's, Devbin devbin-vc's). FILED: 0631, 0632 (behind the line), 0633 (ic), 0634 (hv's ruling); 0527 annotated. OPEN: 0616, 0617, 0618, 0629, 0630, 0631, 0632, 0633, 0634. (2) 0630: ruling (B) proven unsound by its own arm (cc's run, END 18:19Z); ruling (S) taken 18:38Z on cc's shape note 2 (blob e3bbea3c812e): the scan never writes a generated view's row (resync carries view rows forward), record_landed records every view its set carried, doctor's arm is bytes-equal-to-the-row read before and after; banked uncompiled as refs/bank/cc/0630/fix-s (blob 49aa7ea9e7a7, base b5e0fd2b3, patch-id 859b6ee560c5) with its CHANGELOG Fixed line. cc's open question (the watcher re-ingesting at every backstop a view-pattern file no renderer records, read from the source) is ruled 19:28Z MEASURED, not read: two daemon arms banked as fix-s2 (a recorded view replaced by a peer's newer render is ingested once and its row then equals disk; a stray pattern-matching file is ingested at most once); a loop in either is fixed in fix-s2 by the ingest recording the bytes it took in, 3.2.7 only if that is not small. (3) THE TEMPLATES LANDING: templates-c's Rust arms went red on migrated_guards_still_refuse (an unreadable config made the gate refuse every commit); ruling (b) 18:53Z corrected 19:04Z: `intent guards` and `intent lang declared` answer exit 4 ONLY for a config the binary cannot read (no file, not JSON, no intent_version), the gate fails open on 4 saying so and refuses on 1, and a readable config whose guards declaration serde refuses is 1 and refused (the `wehn` arm asserts 1); banked unrun as refs/bank/cc/0616-0618/templates-e (blob 264c1d35c5e2, base 3c08966c9, patch-id bc550e81dc1c). The fixture's config, now readable, made doctor count gate-not-running in those arms; ruled 19:28Z (b): the fixture takes a v2 intent_version, so doctor declines it as it always did and the arms judge the guards alone, banked as templates-f. (4) THE HOST: Utilz's window opened 19:09Z (utilz-dc's 2.14.2 release dry run, then hv's Utilz cut); Intent starts nothing heavy until utilz-vc's cut END by name, which vc relays, and Devbin's bats slot (devbin-cc's WP-08 series at 5059a26e, then devbin-vc's landing suite) runs beside Intent's cargo slot on vc's relay to devbin-vc. THE FIRST KOVACS PREFLIGHT NEVER RAN: kovacs-sysadm found no process, no ~/work/intent-preflight/, no script and no history line at 19:11Z, and kovacs lacks prettier and mix, so the order refuses at its tool check; hv chose in vc's TUI (before vc's 19:28Z clock read) to start it now from hv's own kovacs terminal on f40df8f72, the commit `bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD` names (a green there covers HEAD through the fold commits; it warms kovacs's target so the candidate's run is incremental), once the two tools are installed, the route being hv's word to kovacs-sysadm. (5) AFTER THE BOUNCE, each on vc's GO: ONE COMBINED CARGO RUN in cc's worktree on the composed tree (templates-e and templates-f first, then fix-s and fix-s2 and ic's 0633 re-banked on b129c1b91 as wip-b, the two orders of the last pair compared by write-tree), `cargo build -p intentd` first, fmt, both clippy lines, doc, the whole intentsvcs and intent-cli suites, a red arm re-run with the suspect patch removed before any fix; the shell half in the bats slot after devbin-cc's series; landings in order by literal path on vc's word with the sha: templates (0616, 0617 and 0618 closed together, `intent claude skills sync`, kovacs-sysadm told the gate needs the 3.2.6 pair), fix-s (0630), 0633; vc's build all #2 on the final HEAD, intentd restarted; dc's known-defects re-drive (refs/bank/dc/kd326/drive.sh) and ic's reference set (regen-reference.sh; both halves at that HEAD against v3.2.5; a second shots run) committed before step 3; cc's CHANGELOG audit of every issue closed since v3.2.5 against its landing commit (0611, 0622 and 0623 carry no line yet: a line each, or the reason none is owed); vc runs reference_current_check.sh, the globalfold of intent/wip.md (v3.21, drafted), the board render chain, then READY to hv. hv's hand then: the kovacs preflight on that tip with the in-tree order's two lines, `intent daemon stop`, `bin/devbin build release v3.2.6` (--dry-run first), `bin/int macos prepare`, `bin/int macos publish`, `bin/int brew smoke --reinstall` then `brew unlink intent && brew pin intent && intent daemon restart`, the app swap from target/dist, the site's db/release.json; vc's recommendation (18:43Z) stands: land everything tonight, start the final preflight last thing, cut tomorrow morning on its green. (6) 0629 next session (dc); D55 in Devbin; ST0085 for hv's read; the five .py removals and 0634 in hv's hand. No push, no release.
